scenes.text: Tara has Skills now. A new feature for everyone using Tara.
Skills are elaborate steps or instructions for repetitive tasks. Create them once, and Tara reuses them whenever they're needed.
Four slash commands run the show. Skill-create, skill-update, skill-list, and skill-delete. These commands only work inside the tara-skills channel.
Each command raises a request. Once approved, the skill goes live, and Tara picks it up automatically.
Skills are scoped. Make them global, or specific to a single channel.
Here's an A C L Finder skill. Instructions tell Tara where to find A C L definitions in the dashboard codebase.
A Jira-first coding skill creates a ticket in the example project before any implementation begins.
And a Blend UI skill — always use the shared component library instead of raw markup.
And coming soon — Tara will start creating skills for you, automatically.
Try it out today. Build what matters. Not XYNE.
